verses.english: Ta, Seen, Meem.
These are the signs of the Manifest Book.

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: You are liable to imperil your life [out of distress] that they will not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena

verses.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ
verses.english: If We wish We will send down to them a sign from the sky before which their heads will remain bowed in humility.
verses.transliteration_html: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.english: There does not come to them any new reminder from the All-beneficent but that they disregard it.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.english: They have already denied [the truth], but soon there will come to them the news of what they have been deriding.
verses.transliteration_html: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.transliteration_text: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
verses.english: Have they not regarded the earth, how many of every splendid kind [of vegetation] We have caused to grow in it?
verses.transliteration_html: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin
verses.transliteration_text: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: When your Lord called out to Moses: [saying,] ‘Go to those wrongdoing people,
verses.transliteration_html: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena

verses.english: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not be wary [of Allah]?’

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! I fear they will impugn me,
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

verses.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ
verses.english: and I will become upset and my tongue will fail me. So send for Aaron [to join me].
verses.transliteration_html: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.english: Besides, they have a charge against me, and I fear they will kill me.’
verses.transliteration_text: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Certainly not! Let both of you go with Our signs: We will indeed be with you, hearing [everything].
verses.transliteration_html: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: So approach Pharaoh and say, ‘‘We are indeed envoys of the Lord of the worlds
verses.transliteration_html: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

verses.english: that you let the Children of Israel leave with us.’’ ’

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.english: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Did we not rear you as a child among us, and did you not stay with us for years of your life?
verses.transliteration_html: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena

verses.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.english: Then you committed that deed of yours, and you are an ingrate.’
verses.transliteration_html: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena
verses.transliteration_text: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘I did that when I was astray.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena

verses.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.english: So I fled from you, as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me sound judgement and made me one of the apostles.
verses.transliteration_html: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.english: That you have enslaved the Children of Israel—is that the favour with which you reproach me?’
verses.transliteration_html: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela
verses.transliteration_text: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela

verses.english: He said, ‘And what is ‘‘the Lord of all the worlds?’’ ’

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them,—should you have conviction.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

verses.english: He said to those who were around him, ‘Don’t you hear?!’
He said, ‘Your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers!’

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
verses.english: He said, ‘Indeed your messenger, who has been sent to you, is surely crazy!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘The Lord of the east and the west and whatever is between them—should you exercise your reason.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘If you take up any god other than me, I will surely make you a prisoner!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena

verses.english: He said, ‘What if I bring you something [as an] unmistakable [proof]?’

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Then bring it, should you be truthful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: Thereat he threw down his staff, and behold, it was a manifest python.
verses.transliteration_html: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.english: Then he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white and bright to the onlookers.
verses.transliteration_text: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: He said to the elite [who stood] around him, ‘This is indeed an expert magician
verses.transliteration_html: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.english: who seeks to expel you from your land with his magic. So what do you advise?’
verses.transliteration_html: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Put him and his brother off for a while, and send heralds to the cities
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena

verses.english: to bring you every expert magician.’
So the magicians were gathered for the tryst of a known day,
and the people were told: ‘Will you all gather?!’

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.english: ‘Maybe we will follow the magicians, if they are victors!’
verses.transliteration_html: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena
verses.transliteration_text: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.english: So when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we have a reward if we were to be the victors?’
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.english: He said, ‘Of course; and you will be among members of my inner circle.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.english: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you have to throw!’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.english: So they threw down their sticks and ropes, and said, ‘By the might of Pharaoh, we shall surely be victorious!’
verses.transliteration_html: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona
verses.transliteration_text: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.english: Thereat Moses threw down his staff, and behold, it was swallowing what they had faked.
verses.transliteration_html: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona

verses.english: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating.
They said, ‘We believe in the Lord of all the worlds,
the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: He [i.e. Pharaoh] said, ‘Do you profess faith in Him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Soon you will know! I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘[There is] no harm [in that]! Indeed, we shall return to our Lord.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: Indeed we hope our Lord will forgive us our offences for being the first to believe.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena

verses.arabic: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.english: Then We revealed to Moses, [saying],‘Set out with My servants at night, for you will be pursued.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona

verses.english: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities,
[proclaiming:] ‘These are indeed a small band.
They have aroused our wrath,
and we are alert and fully prepared.’
So We took them out of gardens and springs,
and [made them leave behind] treasures and stately homes.
So it was; and We bequeathed them to the Children of Israel.
Then they pursued them at sunrise.

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.english: When the two hosts sighted each other, the companions of Moses said, ‘Indeed we have been caught up.’
verses.transliteration_html: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.english: He said, ‘Certainly not! Indeed my Lord is with me. He will guide me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.english: Thereupon We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff!’ Whereupon it parted, and each part was as if it were a great mountain.
verses.transliteration_html: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi

verses.english: There, We brought the others near,
and We delivered Moses and all those who were with him.
Then We drowned the rest.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that, but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
Relate to them the account of Abraham

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.english: when he said to his father and his people, ‘What is it that you are worshiping?!’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constant in our devotion to them.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena

verses.english: He said, ‘Do they hear you when you call them?
Or do they bring you any benefit, or cause you any harm?’

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Indeed, we found our fathers doing likewise.’
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona

verses.english: He said, ‘Have you regarded what you have been worshipping,
you and your ancestors?

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: They are indeed enemies to me, but the Lord of all the worlds,
verses.transliteration_html: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena

verses.english: who created me, it is He who guides me,
and provides me with food and drink,
and when I get sick, it is He who cures me;
who will make me die, then He will bring me to life,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.english: and who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Retribution.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.english: ‘My Lord! Grant me [unerring] judgement, and unite me with the Righteous.
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.english: Confer on me a worthy repute among the posterity,
verses.transliteration_text: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena

verses.english: and make me one of the heirs to the paradise of bliss.

verses.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.english: Forgive my father, for he is one of those who are astray.
verses.transliteration_html: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena
verses.transliteration_text: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena

verses.english: Do not disgrace me on the day that they will be resurrected,

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.english: the day when neither wealth nor children will avail,
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
verses.english: except him who comes to Allah with a sound heart,’
verses.transliteration_html: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin
verses.transliteration_text: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin

verses.english: and paradise will be brought near for the Godwary,
and hell will be brought into view for the perverse,

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.english: and they shall be told: ‘Where is that which you used to worship
verses.transliteration_html: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.english: besides Allah? Do they help you, or do they help each other?’
verses.transliteration_html: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona

verses.english: Then they will be cast into it on their faces—they and the perverse,
and the hosts of Iblis all together.
They will say, as they wrangle in it [together],

verses.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.english: ‘By Allah, we had indeed been in manifest error
verses.transliteration_text: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin

verses.english: when we equated you with the Lord of all the worlds!
No one led us astray except the guilty.
Now we have no intercessors,
nor do we have any sympathetic friend.

verses.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: Had there been another turn for us, we would be among the faithful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
The people of Noah impugned the apostles

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: when Noah, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona

verses.english: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.english: So be wary of Allah and obey me.’
They said, ‘Shall we believe in you, when it is the riffraff who follow you?’

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: He said, ‘What do I know as to what they used to do?
verses.transliteration_html: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.english: Their reckoning is only with my Lord, should you be aware.
verses.transliteration_html: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona
verses.transliteration_text: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona

verses.english: I will not drive away the faithful.
I am just a manifest warner.’

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Noah, if you do not desist, you will certainly be stoned [to death].’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena

verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Indeed my people have impugned me.

verses.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: So judge conclusively between me and them, and deliver me and the faithful who are with me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.english: Thereupon We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark.
verses.transliteration_html: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni
verses.transliteration_text: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni

verses.english: Then We drowned the rest.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
[The people of] ‘Ad impugned the apostles,

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: when Hud, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona

verses.english: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.english: Do you build futile a sign on every prominence?
You set up structures as if you will be immortal,
and when you seize [someone for punishment], you seize [him] like tyrants.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.
Be wary of Him who has provided you with whatever you know,
and aided you with sons and with cattle,
gardens and springs.

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.’
verses.transliteration_html: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘It is the same to us whether you exhort us or not.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena

verses.english: These are nothing but the traditions of the ancients,
and we will not be punished.’

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: So they impugned him, whereupon We destroyed them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
[The people of] Thamud impugned the apostles

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: when Salih, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona

verses.english: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.english: Will you be left secure in that which is here
—amid gardens and springs,
farms and date palms with dainty spathes
—while you skillfully hew out houses from the mountains?
So be wary of Allah and obey me,
and do not obey the dictates of the transgressors,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.english: who cause corruption in the land and do not bring about reform.’
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

verses.english: They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched.

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: You are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign, should you be truthful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
verses.english: He said, ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink and you shall drink on known days.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin
verses.transliteration_text: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Do not cause her any harm, for then you shall be seized by the punishment of a terrible day.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin

verses.english: But they hamstrung her, whereupon they became regretful.

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: So the punishment seized them. There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
The people of Lot impugned the apostles

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: when Lot, their brother, said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona

verses.english: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.english: What! Of all people do you come to males,

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
verses.english: abandoning your wives your Lord has created for you? Indeed, you are a transgressing lot.’
verses.transliteration_html: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Lot, if you do not desist, you will surely be banished.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena

verses.english: He said, ‘Indeed I detest your conduct.’
‘My Lord! Deliver me and my family from what they do.’
So We delivered him and all his family,
except an old woman who remained behind.
Then We destroyed [all] the rest,

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.english: and rained down upon them a rain [of stones]. Evil was the rain of those who were warned!
verses.transliteration_html: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena
verses.transliteration_text: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
The inhabitants of Aykah impugned the apostles,

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: when Shu‘ayb said to them, ‘Will you not be wary [of Allah]?
verses.transliteration_html: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona

verses.english: Indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
So be wary of Allah and obey me.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward lies only with the Lord of all the worlds.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
verses.english: Observe the full measure, and do not be of those who give short measure.
verses.transliteration_html: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena
verses.transliteration_text: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena

verses.english: Weigh with an even balance,

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verses.english: and do not cheat the people of their goods. Do not act wickedly on the earth, causing corruption.
verses.transliteration_html: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena
verses.transliteration_text: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

verses.english: Be wary of Him who created you and the earlier generations.’
They said, ‘Indeed you are one of the bewitched.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.english: You are just a human being like us, and we indeed consider you to be a liar.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena

verses.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: Make a fragment of the sky falls upon us, should you be truthful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing.’

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.english: So they impugned him, and then they were overtaken by the punishment of the day of the overshadowing cloud. It was indeed the punishment of a terrible day.
verses.transliteration_html: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: There is indeed a sign in that; but most of them do not have faith.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.english: Indeed your Lord is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
This is indeed [a Book] sent down by the Lord of all the worlds,
brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit
upon your heart (so that you may be one of the warners),
in a clear Arabic language.
It is indeed [foretold] in the scriptures of the ancients.

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.english: Is it not a sign for them that the learned of the Children of Israel recognize it?
verses.transliteration_html: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela
verses.transliteration_text: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela

verses.english: Had We sent it down upon some non-Arab

verses.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: and had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
verses.transliteration_html: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena

verses.english: This is how We let it pass through the hearts of the guilty:

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.english: they do not believe in it until they sight the painful punishment.
verses.transliteration_html: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema
verses.transliteration_text: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema

verses.english: It will overtake them suddenly while they are unaware.
Thereupon they will say, ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’
So do they seek to hasten on Our punishment?
Tell me, should We let them enjoy for some years,
then there comes to them what they have been promised,

verses.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
verses.english: of what avail to them will be that which they were given to enjoy?
verses.transliteration_html: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
verses.english: We have not destroyed any town without its having warners,
verses.transliteration_html: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona

verses.english: for the sake of admonition, and We were not unjust.
It has not been brought down by the devils.
Neither does it behoove them, nor are they capable [of doing that].
Indeed, they are kept at bay [even] from hearing it.

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.english: So do not invoke any god besides Allah, lest you should be among the punished.
verses.transliteration_html: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena
verses.transliteration_text: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena

verses.english: Warn the nearest of your kinsfolk,

verses.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: and lower your wing to the faithful who follow you.
verses.transliteration_html: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena
verses.transliteration_text: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.english: But if they disobey you, say, ‘I am absolved of what you do.’
verses.transliteration_html: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona

verses.english: And put your trust in the All-mighty, the All-merciful,
who sees you when you stand [for prayer],
and your going about among those who prostrate.
Indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.

verses.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
verses.english: Should I inform you on whom the devils descend?
verses.transliteration_html: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu
verses.transliteration_text: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu

verses.english: They descend on every sinful liar.
They eavesdrop, and most of them are liars.
As for the poets, [only] the perverse follow them.

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
verses.english: Have you not regarded that they rove in every valley,
verses.transliteration_html: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona
verses.transliteration_text: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona

verses.english: and that they say what they do not do?

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
verses.english: Barring those who have faith, do righteous deeds, and remember Allah much often, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know at what goal they will end up.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona
verses.transliteration_text: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona
